verdict.rationale: Vanta ships AI features (Vanta AI Agent, AI-powered Trust Center answers, MCP server), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The GDPR privacy-workflow and MCP 'securely query' claims are adjacent features, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
